reason: Check candidate set, confirmed skillIds, mutation lock, and inventory clear rules.
Check that reset deletes only parent skills, cascades the seven owned relations, and prunes empty repositories.
Check FS backup/restore and db_committed atomicity; no unjournaled mass delete.
Check Local reset does not write SSH cache and SSH reset does not write Local db.sqlite.
Check that canRebuild stays false for healthy DBs and reset does not reopen startup rebuild.
Check tests do not open ~/.skillsmanage production paths.
Check confirmation/cancel/failure feedback and redacted error rendering.
Check Operation Log and IPC errors omit paths, URLs, tokens, and SQL.
